import argparse
import collections
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import struct

REC=struct.Struct('<IIIHHQQQ')

def load(blob, expected):
 assert len(blob)%REC.size==0
 records=list(REC.iter_unpack(blob))
 cutoff=max(r[7] for r in records if r[3]==6 and r[7])
 live=[r for r in records if r[3]==29 and r[5]>=cutoff and r[7]]
 groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
 for cu,pc,inst,op,sl,ta,tr,te in live:
  assert (sl&0xc000)==0xc000, 'Missing two-shot phase schema'
  assert cu<0xffffffff and pc<0xffffffff, 'Saturated phase timestamp'
  assert 0<=tr-ta<=cu<=pc<=te-ta, (inst,sl,cu,pc,ta,tr,te)
  groups[inst].append({'slice':sl&0x3fff,'entry':ta,'end':te,
   'gate_rs_us':(tr-ta)/100,'reduce_scatter_us':(cu-(tr-ta))/100,
   'gate_ag_us':(pc-cu)/100,'all_gather_us':(te-ta-pc)/100,
   'body_us':(te-ta)/100})
 assert set(groups)==set(expected), ('Missing/extra live collectives',set(expected)-set(groups),set(groups)-set(expected))
 result=[]
 for inst,rs in sorted(groups.items()):
  assert sorted(r['slice'] for r in rs)==list(range(expected[inst])), (inst,len(rs))
  last=max(rs,key=lambda r:r['end'])
  result.append({'inst':inst,'workgroups':len(rs),
   'entry_to_last_finish_envelope_us':(max(r['end'] for r in rs)-min(r['entry'] for r in rs))/100,
   'last_finishing_workgroup':last,
   'workgroup_medians_us':{k:statistics.median(r[k] for r in rs) for k in ('gate_rs_us','reduce_scatter_us','gate_ag_us','all_gather_us','body_us')}})
 return {'cutoff_latest_embed_end':cutoff,'collectives':result}

def main():
 p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('directory',type=Path);a=p.parse_args()
 root=Path(__file__).parent
 expected={d['idx']:d['blocks'] for d in json.loads((root/'packet-xr.json').read_text())['instructions']}
 ranks={}
 for rank in range(8):
  path=a.directory/f'trace.bin.rk{rank}.prefill'
  r=load(path.read_bytes(),expected)
  r['sum_collective_envelopes_us']=sum(c['entry_to_last_finish_envelope_us'] for c in r['collectives'])
  r['sum_last_finishing_workgroup_phases_us']={k:sum(c['last_finishing_workgroup'][k] for c in r['collectives']) for k in ('gate_rs_us','reduce_scatter_us','gate_ag_us','all_gather_us','body_us')}
  ranks[str(rank)]=r
 report={'ranks':ranks,'clock_ticks_per_us':100,
  'scope':'Rank-local phase durations only. Gate phases include signaling, waiting, acquire, and local barriers. Collective envelopes can overlap and are not a wall-time attribution. Phase medians are not additive critical-path times. Final chunk only, stale records excluded using the latest Embed completion.'}
 (a.directory/'phases.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps({rank:r['sum_last_finishing_workgroup_phases_us'] for rank,r in ranks.items()},indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__': main()
